source.description:
PROBLEM
unitAI-rrdnt.50 landed the CAPABILITY to typecheck tests (tsconfig.test.json + 'bun run typecheck:tests') but not a clean tree. The baseline is 350 errors, so the check cannot be wired into a blocking gate yet. Until it is, a test file can still reference a method that does not exist — which is exactly how host.snapshot() shipped in a self-diagnosing block that would have thrown before printing.

SUCCESS
'bun run typecheck:tests' exits 0, and the check runs in CI alongside the src typecheck.

SCRUTINY
LOW

SCOPE
Test files only. Measured baseline by file, 2026-09-08 at 71eb1439:
  111  tests/unit/pi/specialist-subagents-extension.test.ts
   31  tests/unit/specialist/activation-peer-adapter.test.ts
   19  tests/unit/specialist/script-runner.test.ts
   17  tests/unit/cli/run.test.ts
   14  tests/unit/cli/ps.test.ts
   11  tests/unit/cli/init-global.test.ts
  147  spread across the remainder
The 111 in the extension file are mostly implicit-any on callbacks, because that suite drives an .mjs extension through a dynamic import and gets no types back. Expect that file to need a typed shim rather than 111 individual annotations.

NON_GOALS
Does not change any test's behaviour or assertions. Does not relax strictness in tsconfig.json to make errors disappear — the point is to find defects, and a weakened config finds fewer.

CONSTRAINTS
The suite must stay green throughout: 2310 passing, 188 files. A type-only change that alters runtime behaviour is a regression even if tsc goes quiet.
At least one error is a real drift signal rather than noise — tests/unit/pi/session.test.ts:778 builds a ResolvedToolContract literal missing exposedExtensionSources, i.e. a fake that no longer matches the type it doubles. Triage for that class before mass-annotating; those are the ones this bead exists to catch.

VALIDATION
1. 'bun run typecheck:tests' exits 0.
2. 'bun --bun vitest run tests/unit' still reports 2310 passed.
3. The gate is wired so a future test referencing a non-existent method fails the build.

OUTPUT
A clean typecheck:tests, the gate wired, and a note on any real defect the cleanup uncovered.
source.title: Clear the 350 test-file type errors so typecheck:tests can become a gate
